text:
Olivia: Quick sync — prepping backports of the v0.9 SDK snippet into stable and v0.8 for the marketing release. Need reviewers + green docs preview before the docs cutoff tomorrow 10:00 PT. Who can take a look?
Jordan: I can do stable + v0.9. What's the exact checklist you want me to run through?
Olivia: thanks! checklist: 1) snippet compiles in snippet-runner, 2) docs preview job is green, 3) links point to versioned API, 4) add a short migration note. Pasting the snippet to sanity-check: 
Olivia: ```bash
pip install redwood-inference==0.9.*
python -c "from redwood import Client; print(Client().generate('hello'))"
```
Kevin: heads up — docs CI is flaking on the v0.8 preview due to a packaging cache error. @eng-infra can the cache be cleared? /cc @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: Build queued for preview: docs-preview/v0.9-backport. Status: queued.
Maya: I cleared the cache for that job and re-triggered the preview. Should show up in ~3m.
Jordan: skimmed the snippet, LGTM functionally. Left two tiny nits in the PR comments (typo + link anchor).
Sam: I'm OOO until 4pm PT but can merge after CI is green. Olivia, please re-request my review when CI passes.
Olivia: will do. If preview still fails by cutoff, fallback is ship stable and open a backport ticket for the next patch — but I'd prefer to avoid that.
Kevin: quick note — the examples are gated behind the feature flag ff:docs-new-snippets. Confirming the toggle is enabled in staging.
Olivia: confirmed ff:docs-new-snippets is ON in staging.
Jordan: approving stable PR now. :thumbsup:
Olivia: thanks! Re-requested Sam. Pushed a tiny migration blurb to the top of the guide and fixed the anchor Jordan mentioned. Preview job is showing as running.
deploy-bot: docs-preview/v0.9-backport: Success (logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/12345)
Sam: Approved and merged at 2251234843. CI passed, preview looks good.
Olivia: Excellent — thanks everyone. Filing a quick follow-up to ensure backport tracking: https://issues.redwood.ai/REDOCS-321
Kevin: noted, will monitor for any post-merge link telemetry spikes.
